item.text:
claim labels-if-j
  If the token is in J: J is false; K is true; L is false; M is true. More than one label is true.

claim labels-if-k
  If the token is in K: J is true; K is false; L is false; M is false. Only J's label is true.

claim labels-if-l
  If the token is in L: J is false; K is true; L is false; M is true. More than one label is true.

claim labels-if-m
  If the token is in M: J is false; K is true; L is true; M is true. More than one label is true.

claim token-in-k
  The token is in K because this is the only location under which exactly one label is true.

link labels-if-k supports token-in-k
link labels-if-j opposes token-in-k
link labels-if-l opposes token-in-k
link labels-if-m opposes token-in-k

claim final-answer
  The answer is B.

link token-in-k supports final-answer

model holds final-answer
  confidence 1 assumed
